title: Inner product under square-root probability scaling
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$ that assigns positive mass to every point, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The Euclidean inner product of their images under square-root probability scaling equals their probability-weighted inner product, namely $\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)f(x)g(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
